description: T1H-CTRIO is the drawing identifier for special-purpose controller module in AutomationDirect's Terminator Field I/O collection. A special-purpose controller module provides the function named in its own documentation. Its terminals and signal routing need to be coordinated with the rest of the controller assembly.

For example, in a machine panel with a dedicated feedback or motion interface, use the T1H-CTRIO reference to coordinate special-purpose connectors, signal cable approach and module access. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Other PLC Products/Terminator Field IO/T1H-CTRIO.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep special-purpose connectors, signal cable approach and module access visible in the layout.
